alert.title: SOS from {name}
alert.body: {name} needs help and is sharing their location. Open FamilyHub to see where they are and call them.
alert.bodyNoLocation: {name} needs help. Open FamilyHub and try to call them now.

body.false_alarm: {name} says the SOS was a false alarm.
body.closed: The SOS alert from {name} was closed.

bodyByOther.false_alarm: {resolver} marked the SOS from {name} as a false alarm.

errors.notOwner: Only the person who sent this SOS can share their location for it.
errors.resolveNotAllowed: Only the person who sent this SOS or a family admin can end it.
errors.notActive: This SOS alert has already ended. Send a new SOS if you still need help.
errors.locationSharingDisabled: Your location sharing is set to Never, so your location is not shared. You can change this in Settings.
